entities.summary: Anna Constantia Thynne, Lady John Thynne daughter of the Rev. Charles Cobbe Beresford and Amelia, daughter of Sir William Montgomery, 1st Baronet, she was a British marine zoologist. In 1846, she built the first stable and sustained marine aquarium and maintained corals and sponges in it for over three years.
